panels.description: Falcon maintenance room: Sitara and Nayah stand in a cramped chamber while Sitara’s separate TJ projects a directional borehole map labeled SCIENTIFIC DRILLING / ENVIRONMENTAL MONITORING; unauthorized branches descend toward resource markers. Leave the top clear.

A physical manifest lies beside a concealed waste chute. ICE CORE STORAGE has overwritten DRILL FLUID / RESIDUALS. Nayah photographs the page while Sitara studies the vibration trace. Leave the upper third clear.

Two synchronized displays show drilling vibration below and ice-motion plots above, with matching timing. A red timestamp-and-coordinate fragment is handwritten across a maintenance sheet. Leave upper-left clear.
The TJ turns toward a sealed archive slot containing paper records, a dead data wafer, and a warning fragment marked 07:14 / ———. Leave upper-right clear.

items.speaker: NAYAH
items.text: That is not an ice-core manifest.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: It is pretending to be one.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: The vibration is local. The instability is not.
